newsitem.title: USA: Colorado MEDtech to buy Erbtec.
newsitem.headline: Colorado MEDtech to buy Erbtec.

text.p: Colorado MEDtech Inc and Erbtec Engineering Inc said on Monday they have entered into an agreement for Colorado MEDtech to acquire the operating assets of Erbtec.
Erbtec, located in Boulder, is a privately held, 17-year-old company with annual revenue of $10 - $12 million, the companies said in a joint statement.
The transaction is expected to close on October 1, 1997. Consideration will be primarily cash with some stock, but the exact amounts were not immediately available.
Erbtec engages in the development, manufacture and sale of electronic products for sale in the United States and Asia, the companies said.
Erbtec's main products are high power radio frequency (RF) amplifiers and systems for Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) equipment, the companies said.
Colorado MEDtech develops and makes electronic and electromechanical products and software systems for the medical device industry.
